positioning: Build like you have a team. Your Mac. Your agents. Your rules.

validation.physicalModePanelTest: Passed in a disposable distinct native app through approved installed OpenSky; exact-window macOS/Vision capture used on the secondary display.

scope: Panel previews use labelled disposable sample clients. The isolated app has a distinct bundle identity. These results do not establish universal background app support or an agent orchestrator.
limitations: Screen-wide OpenSky capture currently targets the primary display; exact-window fixture instrumentation verified the secondary-display panel.
The new production app still needs installation and actual macOS permission readback; disposable identity permission results do not establish production consent.
